chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 91h online + 3h offline (optional) + 1h Final exam + 55h self-study
chung.Description:
This course is derived from the Coursera Specialization "Advanced Digital Transformation Specialization."

This specialization is composed of three courses. Each offers a different perspectives on digital technology in the strategic context. Whether you’re an IT professional looking to move up or a seasoned executive hoping to keep up, this specialization will help you drive change that matters. Let’s dive into the specifics

1. Leading with a Digital Strategy (Course 1)

Understand digital capabilities and their strategic impact

Explore lenses for conceptualizing digital transformation

Learn about key concepts underlying successful digital initiatives

Discover how scientific thinking plays a crucial role in mastering digital transformation

2. How to Transform Digitally? (Course 2)

Identify notable strategies and business models for successful digital transformations, in the modern age characterized by advanced and artificially intelligent technologies

Transform digital elements (Digital Architecture, Work, Governance, Business Models) effectively.

Analyze challenges and learn the DaWoGoMo model for organizational transformation

Explore the operational purpose driving digital change

3. Transforming Life and Organization in the Digital Age (Course 3)

Understand major technological trends driving digital transformation of our lives

Learn the evolutionary and natural purposes driving digital transformation.

Champion initiatives for your life and growth by mastering the existential purpose

Identify business and life opportunities arising from digital transformation
chung.StudentTasks:
This Course is based on the Coursera Specialization "Advanced Digital Transformation Specialization."

Students have to:
- complete the course on Coursera platform prior to deadline.
- attend offline sessions scheduled on FAP for instruction and guidance (optional)
chung.Note:
1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.
2) Final Exam (FE) = Theoretical Exam (TE)
3) Final Result (FR) = min (10, TE + Bonus)
4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5
